title: What salt tastes the best? Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs and more
summary: The Explosions&Fire channel taste-tests the chloride salts of the alkali metals (lithium through cesium), plus some alkaline earth metals and ammonium. The presenter describes the flavors, and the results are more pleasant than expected.
why: It gets linked in threads about salt and taste as a quirky, memorable curiosity.

quote.text: One of my favorite random youtube videos
